scope: Static source/diff review only. No promoter execution, new tests, AWS/VPS actions or source mutation.
checks: Both candidate hashes and both active A5 target hashes are checked before durable intent or replacement. Metadata requires regular file, single link and current UID.
Service d878, wrapper e299, collector161, metadata parser498 and identity provisioner5280 are hash-checked unchanged modules, not promotion targets.
An existing promotion receipt blocks a fresh invocation. Intent is created exclusively mode0600 and fsynced before any target replacement.
Existing backups are retained only if their bytes match the old hash. Missing backups are created exclusively with O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW, mode0600 and fsync; no backup is overwritten or deleted.

Each target is rechecked at the old hash with its backup, then a new exclusive stage file is written/fsynced and checked against the new hash before os.replace. Target readback must match the new hash.

Each completed row is journaled. Caught failure records partial_requires_reconciliation without automatic rollback or replay; process interruption can leave intent/partial state, which still blocks rerun.
Only these two active files are replaced. Additional writes are their named backups/stages and the A6 promotion receipt. No AWS/VPS calls or live proof invocation is present.
limits: The two-file promotion is not one atomic transaction and does not implement automatic recovery. Reconciliation must inspect actual target/stage/backup hashes; promoted[] can lag a completed replace if interrupted before its journal update.
The operation is for the coordinator's serialized local source window. It does not claim compare-and-swap against concurrent writers.
